boundaries: Focus on probability identities; empirical probabilities must be explicitly supplied or independently evidenced.

Odds are a ratio representation, not evidence of advantage; total-probability partitions must be stated exhaustive and disjoint

mission: Curate atomic, reusable scalar probability identities with explicit event meaning, population and dependence assumptions, including odds and total-probability accounting alongside the core identities. priorities: Conditional probability with nonzero conditioning probability
Two-event Bayes identity with all required probabilities supplied

special_checks: Guard probabilities within [0,1], denominators above zero, and joint probabilities against marginals
